claims.disproof_condition: Lower if the agreement is terminated/renegotiated below the 50% share, or if Humanoid's platform volumes fail to materialize (watch first Germany go-lives by end-2026 and cumulative deployments vs the four-digit 2032 target); upgrade to clean customer commitment only if prepayment/equity or non-reciprocal terms are disclosed.
claims.statement: Customer-side binding terms now quantify the Schaeffler→Humanoid actuator relationship: 5-year agreement, Schaeffler as preferred supplier covering MORE THAN 50% of Humanoid's joint-actuator demand for wheeled platforms through 2031, expected seven-digit actuator volumes. Substitutability judged 3/5: a binding majority-share commitment is a real lock, but the remaining <50% stays open and the term is finite. ⚠ Reciprocity honestly flagged: the same deal has Schaeffler deploying a four-digit number of Humanoid robots under a RaaS model (Schaeffler pays Humanoid for robot services) — both parties are each other's customers with no equity/prepayment disclosed, so per this graph's payment-direction discipline the commitment is NOT counted as clean customer-to-supplier capital commitment (POET rule); it is a strong reciprocal design-in.

source_doc.title: Humanoid announcement — landmark deal with Schaeffler (supply terms excerpts)

sources.quote: Humanoid has also signed a 5-year supply agreement with Schaeffler for supply of actuators. Under this agreement, Schaeffler will become Humanoid's preferred supplier, covering more than 50% of the company's demand for joint actuators for its wheeled-based platforms through 2031.
This partnership is expected to translate into the supply of a seven-digit number of actuators.

The agreement is structured around a Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. Under this model, Humanoid provides the robotic systems together with the related services required for end-to-end deployment and operation.
It targets deployment of a four-digit number of wheeled units across Schaeffler's global facilities by 2032.
